tasks.task_text: Pick the die from the marked start zone and release it inside the cup at its marked location.
tasks.success_rule: The die is inside the cup, confirmed by the operator and front-camera still.
scene_requirements: The cup occupies its fixed marked location.
The die starts inside the fixed marked start zone.
The cup, die and gripper remain visible in the fixed front-camera view.

tasks.task_text: Pick the loaded cup from its marked location, shake it and invert it over the fixed dump tray.
tasks.success_rule: The die is at rest on the fixed dump tray and the cup was not dropped, confirmed by the operator and front-camera evidence.
scene_requirements: The cup contains the die and occupies its fixed marked location.
The dump tray is fixed in the declared camera-visible location.
The cup, gripper and dump tray remain visible during the trial.

tasks.task_text: Return the cup from the declared post-dump pose to its fixed marked location and release it upright.
tasks.success_rule: The cup is upright on its fixed mark, confirmed by the operator and front-camera still.
scene_requirements: The cup begins in the declared post-dump pose visible to the cameras.
The cup return location has a fixed visible mark.
The die remains in the fixed dump tray and is not part of the return grasp.
